response.justification: Bogdan has extensive experience in software development, distributed systems, and infrastructure, but his background does not strongly align with the core requirements of the role, particularly 8+ years of C++ experience and leadership in cloud compute platforms. His expertise in web, mobile, and embedded systems, while valuable, does not directly match the heavy focus on C++ and large-scale cloud infrastructure. However, his technical breadth and leadership in open-source projects and mentoring warrant further evaluation.
strengths: Strong background in distributed systems and large-scale infrastructure (e.g., micro-services at Dunnhumby, Kubernetes at GISCollective)
Proven leadership and mentorship (e.g., organizing Refactoring Dojos, Selenium courses, and workshops)
Experience with DevOps practices (CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes) and cloud-related technologies (AWS CDK, node.js)
concerns: Limited C++ experience (only 2 years at National Instruments, no recent or deep cloud compute platform leadership)
Lack of explicit production-level cloud architecture experience balancing short- and long-term needs
No direct experience in cloud compute platform technical leadership or mentoring cloud/DevOps engineers
